mn128:7.1: Bālakaloṇakāra: the name means ‘village of the salt-workers’.
mn128:14.3: For this account of the bhikkhus’ diligent routine, cf. Sutta 31 (Cūḷagosiṅgasutta), of which this passage is an abbreviated repetition in the Pali.
mn128:21.3: For duṭṭhulla (‘inertia’) in this sense, cf. Sutta 64 and Sutta 127.
mn128:26.6: Atinijjhāyitattaṁ (‘too much meditating on’) shares its root with jhāna; cf. Sutta 95.
